_comment: Runtime code read from Arbitrum One (eth_getCode, November 2026): an account's ERC-1967 proxy (LibClone's), Alchemy's Modular Account v2 implementation (ModularAccount, verified on Sourcify) and Aave Labs' MultiSigValidationModule (verified on Sourcify). The operation: one of that account's, validating through the module (entity ID 1, global), as its bundle carried it, with its hash from its UserOperationEvent; its validation's storage word and the module's signers for it, read from the chain.
